🆕 New listing (Posted: October 28, 2026)

A group job interview event for job seekers aged 59 and under. No written application required — you can meet company representatives directly and get advice on your job search.

【Event Date and Time】
January 15, 2027 (Reiwa 9), Friday, 1:00 PM – 4:00 PM
(Reception opens at 12:30 PM)

【Venue】
Hanno Citizen Activity Center, Multipurpose Hall

【Participating Companies】
Approximately 10 companies

【Capacity】
50 people (first come, first served)

【Registration Opens】
Monday, November 9, 2026 (Reiwa 8)

【How to Apply】
Reserve by phone or on the Saitama Job Support website.

Phone: 049-265-5844
Office hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (closed weekends and holidays)

For details about participating companies, check the Saitama Job Support website.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kankyokeizaibu/sangyoshinkoka/14323.html
